title: Nothing you can see changed: the 1965 porch photograph re-measured
items: Nothing you can see changed. The camera for the 1965 colour slide of 1808 Prairie's loggia is fitted again, this time on the loggia's own columns and pedestal as well as the round bay's windows. Even on that camera the slide draws the loggia, and the bay's upper wall, about a third taller than the model, so the gap is between the two old pictures and not the camera. Which picture is wrong is now an open question for the Keith house's photo check.
